column1: Details of Mr and Mrs E

column2: Mr E is an SC and Mrs E is an SPR

Mr E has been working since July 2023, and his average gross monthly income for the 12 months worked between July 2023 and June 2024 was $2,300. Mrs E worked only in December 2023 to February 2024, and her average gross monthly income for the 3 months worked was $2,100.
Mr and Mrs E will each receive a Family Grant of $35,000 and an EHG of $35,000.
